**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

What looks good
- The diff is exactly the removal of `assert_eq!(project::PROJECT_VERSION, 51, ..)` in `crates/app/tests/probe_op.rs` (replaced by an explanatory comment) plus `docs/decisions/344-probe-version-pin.md`. The kind id / digest-tag loop the test exists to pin is untouched.
- Test-only change, so there are no Prime Directive, command, layering or clean-room concerns. No build.rs, scripts, workflows or dependency changes.
- Body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #344`; the decision file follows the per-issue convention.

Local results (merged with current origin/main, clean trial merge, no conflicts)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test probe_op`: 11 passed, 0 failed (including `every_older_kind_keeps_its_stored_id_and_digest_tag`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking): none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
